title: What It Actually Looks Like to Celebrate the Groom and Still Hold Him to His Vows
caption:
Wedding season is coming, and you're in a lot of them.

Most groomsmen think the job is a rented suit, a loud bachelor party, and a speech full of ex stories. That's the world's version.

The godly version: plan a weekend he never has to hide. Bless the covenant out loud. Stand up there as a witness, not a prop. And call him three months in, when the photos are done and the real marriage starts.

If you're single, don't leave the reception hungry. Watch what a covenant costs a man, and keep chasing God.

Save this for the next wedding. Send it to the guy who asked you to stand up for him.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #marriage #brotherhood
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
